title: Theft In Reserved AC Coach: Pathankot Consumer Commission Holds Northern Railway Liable
description: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Pathankot, comprising President Kulwinder Singh Pannu and Member Raj Kumar Shukla, held Northern Railway liable for deficiency in service following the theft of a passenger's handbag from a reserved AC coach. The Commission observed that although Railways are generally not liable for the loss of unbooked luggage, liability would arise where the loss is attributable to the negligence of railway staff.
